caption: I've noticed my phone can keep me up at night. Sometimes I use it before bed and I may not sleep as well. Here are some mini steps: turn off my phone an hour before bed, use a book or magazine instead, and charge my phone in another room
comments_seeded: Do you think phones are affecting our sleep without us realizing it?
I've heard that the blue light from phones can be linked to poor sleep
What do you do to wind down before bed?
It's interesting how small changes to our bedtime routine can make a difference
Have you ever noticed a difference in your sleep when you don't use your phone before bed?
